home.sections.label: Sections, and their order
home.sections.hint: Drag a section up or down to move it, or untick it to leave it out. A section you leave out keeps everything in it, so ticking it again brings it back as it was.

home.meta.title.label: Search title
home.meta.title.hint: The full browser tab and search result title for the home page. The company name is not added after it.

home.meta.description.value: Practical training and coaching, delivered personally. Courses, workshops and one-to-one work.
home.meta.description.label: Search description
home.meta.description.hint: The sentence Google shows under the page title in search results. Around 150 to 160 characters; longer is cut off mid-word.

home.hero.eyebrow.label: Hero eyebrow
home.hero.eyebrow.hint: The small line above the headline. A credential or a claim you can stand behind. Leave empty and it does not appear.

home.hero.heading.value:
Practical agile training
and coaching, delivered personally.
home.hero.heading.label: Hero heading
home.hero.heading.hint: The h1. A line break splits it in two

home.hero.background.label: Hero background picture
home.hero.background.hint: Sits behind the headline, very faint. Leave it empty and the hero is a plain colour, which is a fine way for it to look. Wide and short works best.

home.hero.subtitle.value: Work better together. Accelerate time to value.
home.hero.subtitle.label: Hero subtitle

home.stats.items.label: Statistics
home.stats.items.hint: The bar under the hero. Add as many or as few as you like; leave it empty and the bar does not appear. A figure with nothing behind it is a claim, so only add the ones you can stand behind.

home.personas.items.label: Who is this for, cards
home.personas.items.hint: One card per kind of person you work with. Add or remove as many as you like; leave it empty and the whole section disappears.

fields.label: Card body
fields.placeholder: Who they are and what they need.

home.courses.empty.title.label: Courses error title
home.courses.empty.title.hint: Shown only when the courses fail to load

home.courses.empty.body.label: Courses error body
home.courses.empty.body.hint: Shown only when the courses fail to load

home.kb.badge.label: Knowledge badge
home.kb.badge.hint: The teal Knowledge Base section, hidden unless that module is on

home.kb.heading.label: Knowledge heading
home.kb.heading.hint: A line break splits it in two

home.kb.body.value: From Story Mapping to OKRs - every technique explained with purpose, usage, origins, and real examples. Searchable, filterable, and built for practitioners.
home.kb.body.label: Knowledge body

home.kb.tags.value:
Story Mapping
OKRs
5 Whys
Business Model Canvas
Impact Mapping
Retrospectives
home.kb.tags.label: Knowledge base examples
home.kb.tags.hint: The small tags under the knowledge base blurb, one per line. Examples of what is in there. Leave empty and no tags appear.

home.cta.heading.value:
Ready to work with someone
who's been in the room?
home.cta.heading.label: Closing heading
home.cta.heading.hint: The orange band at the foot of the page

home.cta.body.value: Browse upcoming courses or book a free chemistry session to talk through what you need. No hard sell - just a conversation.
home.cta.body.label: Closing body
home.cta.body.hint: The orange band at the foot of the page

home.cta.events.label: Closing button, browse
home.cta.events.hint: The orange band at the foot of the page

home.cta.booking.label: Closing button, booking
home.cta.booking.hint: The orange band at the foot of the page

home.founder.eyebrow.label: Founder section, small heading
home.founder.eyebrow.hint: The small line above the founder heading.

home.founder.years.label: Years of experience badge
home.founder.years.hint: The orange number on the photograph, for example 25. Leave empty and the badge does not appear.

home.founder.credentials.label: Credentials beside the photograph
home.founder.credentials.hint: One per line, kept short: these sit in a narrow column. Leave empty and the list does not appear.

home.founder.heading.value:
Train with someone
who has been in the room.
home.founder.heading.label: Founder heading
home.founder.heading.hint: The large serif heading beside the photograph. A line break splits it in two, and the second line is set in italics.

home.founder.body.label: Founder section, introduction
home.founder.body.hint: Two sentences about whoever runs this.

home.founder.quote.label: Founder quote
home.founder.quote.hint: The pulled-out line beside the orange rule. Something the founder believes, in their own words. Leave empty and the quote does not appear.

home.founder.cta.label: Founder section, link
home.founder.cta.hint: The link through to the About page.

home.founder.bookCta.label: Founder booking button
home.founder.bookCta.hint: The orange button beside the photograph. It opens the booking link from Settings.
